# GCC runtime licenses

License texts for the GCC 16.2.0 runtimes linked into container executables:

- `gcc/COPYING3`: GCC source `COPYING3`.
- `gcc/COPYING.RUNTIME`: GCC Runtime Library Exception, source `COPYING.RUNTIME`.
- `gcc/libsanitizer-LICENSE.txt`: source `libsanitizer/LICENSE.TXT`.

Copied from <https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/tree/releases/gcc-16.2.0>.
Keep these in step with `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` when updating GCC.
